name: ANTONINO COLOSIMO
bioAdditions: Antonio/Antonino Colosimo was buried on 7 January 1673 (S1). The tree has two profiles with this exact death date, I282824815695 and I282824816434; they are almost certainly the same man, the husband of Angila Vaccaro and father of Antonio (bapt. 15 Jun 1659).

conflicts.siteValue: I282824815695 and I282824816434 both Antonino Colosimo d. 7 Jan 1673
